calculation_handling.description: Whether a platform floor is higher than the first floor of the building depends on as-designed platform and first floor heights, which the lot data does not hold.
calculation_handling.gaps: The platform floor height relative to the first floor above established grade is not a lot-data input.

units.disclosure: On these lands, in a front yard or rear yard, a platform whose floor is higher than the first floor of the building above established grade may not encroach into the required yard setback. This is not evaluated automatically; check the platform floor height against the first floor.

instrument.citation: Section 12(2) 3 of former City of Toronto By-law 438-86

calculation_handling.description: An alternate compliance path under former City of Toronto By-law 438-86; never evaluated.

units.disclosure: Section 12(2) 3 of former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 continues to prevail on these lands as an alternate path; it is not evaluated here.

900.3.10(1392).explanation: Exception RD 1392: in a front yard or rear yard, a platform with a floor higher than the first floor above established grade may not encroach into the required yard setback. Section 12(2) 3 of former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 also prevails.
